name: How do you ensure proper waterproofing for a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure proper waterproofing for a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper waterproofing is critical for walk-in showers to prevent leaks and protect your home's structure from moisture damage. Our process involves multiple layers of protection, starting with a sloped subfloor to direct water toward the drain. We then apply waterproof membranes or liquid-applied sealants to the shower pan, walls, and curb (if present) before tiling. All seams, corners, and penetrations for plumbing fixtures are meticulously sealed to create a continuous, impenetrable barrier. This rigorous approach ensures long-term durability and peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure proper waterproofing with a sloped subfloor, waterproof membranes applied to the pan and walls, and meticulous sealing of all seams and penetrations.
